digest.component_or_area: Comprehensive quality audit remediation (CI, docs, module refactoring, graph complexity, type safety)
propositions: Python 3.11 xdist worker flakes in test_opcert_service_app test teardown under CPU/memory contention, manifesting as benign OSError after test suite completion
User-facing documentation teaches an assignee example that resolves consistently with docs/config.md and Jira configuration
Near-cap modules structured_run.py, compact.py, and event_append.py are refactored by responsibility/layer to reduce duplication and improve maintainability while preserving public import paths

Graph traversal functions (_find_direct_blockers, _get_all_blocked_by, check_cycle_at_level, detect_newly_unblocked) have duplicated loader infrastructure that increases cyclomatic complexity below the threshold when centralized
The attest package lacks complete type annotations required to pass mypy --disallow-untyped-defs
All refactoring changes affect only non-contended files to avoid conflicts with 212 concurrent in-progress tickets
